title: zigadenus virescens
intro: Zigadenus virescens, commonly known as the Death Camas, is a perennial plant species native to the western United States and southwestern Canada. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Death Camas are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and reduce inflammation. Bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
